messages:
Vik: Flagging a small but repeatable fp8 regression on gpt-mini during the canary today. Drops concentrated on list+number extraction slices.
Asha: How big is "small"?
Vik: ~0.7% absolute drop aggregated over the slice, 400 samples in 20m window.
Liam: Which quant profile? fp8-v1, fp8-v2?
Vik: fp8-v3. Canary rolled to 20% at 02:10 UTC.
Rohit: ops-bot: canary state?
ops-bot: Canary: gpt-mini fp8-v3 @20% since 02:10 UTC. Alert triggered for slice "list_numbers" at 02:28 UTC.
Asha: OK pattern matches prior incidents. Two parallel asks: (1) quick ops controls so oncall can pause/rollback + shadow a slice, (2) longer-term: a manifest + runtime hooks for slice-aware fallbacks and diagnostics.
Liam: Agree. For (2) propose a minimal "quant-manifest" schema teams attach to rollouts. Fields: model, profile, slices (predicate), thresholds, shadow_rate, fallback_profile, diag_level.
Rohit: Can we show a small example inline?
Liam: Example manifest in chat (conceptual):
quant_manifest:
  model: gpt-mini
  profile: fp8-v3
  slices:
    - name: list_numbers
      filter: "numeric_count>1 and list_tokens>5"
  thresholds:
    quality_delta_pct: 0.5
    min_samples: 100
  shadow_rate: 0.3
  fallback_profile: int8-mix
  diag_level: low
Asha: UX: Console should show a slice card with pctl drop, sample count, small sparkline and a "pause/rollback" CTA. Also a one-click "ramp shadow to X" control.
Vik: Runtime: if slice breaches threshold for 5m, auto-route that slice to fallback_profile for 10m. Must be opt-out per-customer.
Rohit: Telemetry: add cheap sampled counters: per-head mean/std, sign-flip counter, percent-identical-output. Full histograms opt-in.
diag-bot: Note: enabling per-head histograms increases CPU by ~5% during collection window. Use short timeboxes.
Liam: Implementation plan: (a) manifest -> API validation and storage, (b) runtime predicate evaluation + tagging, (c) lightweight diagnostic hooks, (d) Console slice card + controls.
Asha: Quick-mitigation runbook: pause promotion, ramp shadow for slice to 0.5, run targeted A/B vs fp16 baseline on 1k matched samples, collect per-example diffs. If consistent > threshold, rollback.
Vik: I'll run the A/B and post results here. Can ops enable high-shadow for an hour?
Rohit: Ops can enable 1h high-shadow via ops UI. I'll toggle now.
ops-bot: Shadow rate for slice list_numbers ramped to 0.5 for 1h at 02:34 UTC. Canary hold at 20%.
Asha: One more product idea: client-side quality hint header (e.g., X-Quality-Budget) so the runtime can select a profile when safe. Need deterministic logs for auditing.
Liam: That opens many policy questions (determinism, side-effect calls). Add a flag side_effects_allowed default false; if false, force higher-precision baseline.
Vik: Action items: Vik - run A/B + logs (ETA 12h); Liam - draft quant-manifest RFC + runtime hooks (ETA 4d); Rohit - ops UI quick toggle (ETA 48h); Asha - Console slice card mock (ETA 3d).
Asha: I'll create an ops runbook snippet for quant-canary failures and link the manifest RFC when ready.
Vik: Results incoming. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
